description: This file defines classes and functions related to a Vault implementation for cryptographic key management, including a specialized Netflix Vault. It includes class declarations, external references, and constants for cryptographic operations.

classes.name: Vault
classes.description: Represents a cryptographic vault with key management capabilities, including size, import/export, and deletion of keys.

classes.name: VaultNetflix
classes.description: Specialized vault class for Netflix-specific key management, including handling of bound keys, ESN, and key handles.

classes.name: Implementation::IdStore
classes.description: Structure holding identifiers for HMAC and AES keys.

classes.name: Implementation::MapStore
classes.description: Data store class for managing key exportability, identifiers, and key length.

methods.name: Vault::Size
methods.description: Returns the size of the key or object associated with the given ID.

methods.name: Vault::Import
methods.description: Imports a key blob into the vault, returning a handle or ID.

methods.name: Vault::Export
methods.description: Exports a key or object from the vault into a buffer.

methods.name: Vault::Put
methods.description: Stores a key blob into the vault.

methods.name: Vault::Get
methods.description: Retrieves a key or object from the vault by ID.

methods.name: Vault::Delete
methods.description: Deletes a key or object from the vault by ID.

methods.name: Vault::ImportNamedKey
methods.description: Imports a named key from a file.

methods.name: Vault::CreateNamedKey
methods.description: Creates a new named key with specified exportability and type.

methods.name: Vault::CheckNamedKey
methods.description: Checks if a named key exists.

methods.name: VaultNetflix::loadBoundKeys
methods.description: Loads bound keys from a buffer.

methods.name: VaultNetflix::GetNamedKey
methods.description: Retrieves a key handle for a named key.

methods.name: VaultNetflix::AddKey
methods.description: Adds a key handle to the internal map.

methods.name: VaultNetflix::DeleteKeyFromMap
methods.description: Removes a key handle from the internal map.

methods.name: VaultNetflix::GetNewKeyHandle
methods.description: Generates and returns a new key handle.

methods.name: VaultNetflix::getKeyInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about a key handle.

methods.name: VaultNetflix::FindKey
methods.description: Finds a key handle by its handle value.

methods.name: VaultNetflix::FindNamedKey
methods.description: Finds a key handle by its name.
